agent_answer.notes: Corpus is a synthetic collection of 20 papers (S001-S020), each a question-answering evaluation study. 'Methods/system variants' = the answer conditions each paper compares. The recurring axis is parametric/closed-book/no-retrieval vs. retrieval-augmented (RAG); additional variants across papers include fine-tuned models, self-consistency/voting decoding, query-rewriting/reformulation, chain-of-thought prompting, RAG with random (unretrieved) passages, and RAG without reranking. Claims claim-000001..claim-000058 record the per-pair condition quotes from each Method section. f1 (row r1) is the aggregate conclusion; f22-f41 (row r2) mirror the per-paper facts with their recorded claims. All 20 papers rest on.

cells.conclusion: The papers compare parametric/closed-book (no-retrieval) answer systems against retrieval-augmented (RAG) variants and other system variants (fine-tuned, self-consistency/voting, query-rewriting, chain-of-thought, RAG-with-random, RAG-without-reranking). Across the 20 papers, every study contrasts at least a parametric-only / closed-book / no-retrieval baseline with a retrieval-augmented condition, and several add further variants.
